The '''Z2 Stun Baton''' was a refined version of the original [[Stun baton/Legends|stun baton]] manufactured by [[Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc./Legends|Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc.]]. It featured an adjuster knob to enhance the [[Weapon/Legends|weapon's]] effect. At higher power levels, it could cause more damage but drained its energy cells much quicker. It was used by both the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[New Republic Security Force]].
